['Erdgas Münster GmbH '].company_description: The Erdgas Münster GmbH is a German natural gas transmission company. The company collects natural gas from wells in the northern German natural gas fields, processes it for sale, and makes it available to the market.

['Wellergruppe GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: Wellergruppe GmbH & Co. KG operates in the automotive industry, offering services related to the rental of motor vehicles of all kinds, as well as associated services.
